_readme: Site photo gallery on the projects page. Every item comes from the client's batch 1 (numbers as in docs/photo-triage.xlsx) and is rated A or B, with no camera stamps, no police or military sites and no third-party branding. Faces appear only where the client confirmed publishing permission (client answers batch 2, 2026-09-16). "alt" describes what is visible only — never a project name. "project" is empty on purpose: it takes the project number from projects-inventory.xlsx once the client confirms which project each photo shows, and only then may the photo also appear on a project card.
